resources.string: Lets MouseCorsul perform taps, long presses, scrolls and drags at the position of its on-screen cursor when you use the virtual touchpad. It does not read your screen content. It only starts working after you press Start inside the app.

How to use:
1. Grant the overlay permission.
2. Open accessibility settings, find MouseCorsul Touchpad and turn it on.
3. Come back here and press Start.

Touchpad panel:
- One finger moves the cursor.
- Tap = click.
- Hold finger still = right click (long press).
- Two fingers up/down = scroll.
- Buttons: Click, Double, Right, Drag (toggle), scroll up/down, Stop.
- Drag: turn Drag ON, then touch the pad and move your finger. The drag starts at the cursor.
- Move the panel by dragging its title bar.

Note: Android has no real right mouse button, so Right click is a long press.
Turn on MouseCorsul Touchpad in accessibility settings first
